answers.core:
- It makes `OptionButton.add_item` similar to the function `ListItem.add_item` and adds consistency between control nodes.
- I don't think Godot node's returns can be changed via an add-on.
- It's a small workflow improvement.
answers.workaround:
Yes it can. You can call `OptionButton.item_count` to get the index where the item will be placed next.
```
var index: int = OptionButton.item_count
OptionButton.add_item("Option 3")
OptionButton.set_item_tooltip(index, "This is the tooltip")
OptionButton.set_metadata(index, {"empty": true})
```

title: Make `OptionButton` add_item functions return the index of the added item.
